== Ingredients ==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] ({{convert|125|ml|USoz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lime|lime juice]]
*¼ cup ({{convert|85|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
*4 serrano [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] (seeded if you want)
*1 cup ({{convert|250|ml|USoz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients in a large mason jar and keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.
